determinism_fix: all pretrained GPT-2 dropout modules set to p=0 before warm start
determinism_gate: fixed-state and restored-state response repeat errors <= 1e-12
acceptance_gate: every constrained arm-budget record accepts at least one step and zero-step fraction < 0.95
confirmation_rule: at both budgets, positive median source-minus-current and budgeted-AdamW-minus-current loss with current dual-winning at least four of five seeds
claim_policy: confirms matched-budget ordering only; unconstrained AdamW remains an excluded diagnostic
